Its 2.875 in OD is therefore not a determination of the G3 post OD. The G3 schedule's 'FOOTING: SEE NOTE 4' reference is imprecise because note 4 concerns width and post size, but the same G3 detail points to 3/F501 and the general fallback (F502 note 5, 32 31 13 3.2.D) does too.
